data.long_meaning: Prmod is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pramodhana', meaning 'protector, lord'. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Prmod usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
